working_tree_semantics: Round 6 was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. Existing user documentation changes were preserved. No files were staged, committed, or pushed.

authority_contract.configuration: typed user < explicitly trusted workspace < explicit Host override whole-entry merge; ordinary Host open leaves repository-owned entries disabled; server cache hints are ignored
authority_contract.physical_owner: one Host-scoped McpSupervisor owns connect, reconnect, discovery, transport, and physical close
authority_contract.runtime_generation: descriptor, effect policy, McpSlotLease, and physical executor are frozen from one semantic and physical generation
authority_contract.transport_concurrency: stdio and sessionful HTTP are serialized; only proved-stateless HTTP receives bounded parallel lanes
authority_contract.dirty_fence: listChanged closes new dispatch immediately; already admitted permits drain; safe-point reconcile installs the successor surface
authority_contract.prefix_continuity: semantic-identical physical reconnect preserves the Round 3.1 epoch; schema change rebases only at a provider safe point
authority_contract.permission: provider schema is permission-invariant; local authorize owns READ_ONLY versus EXTERNAL_EFFECT policy
authority_contract.confirmation: builtin and MCP confirmations share one Host-wide bounded FIFO and visible slot; MCP acquires a generation-bound dispatch permit before publication
authority_contract.input_required: bounded keyed state-only continuation; unsupported branches are a known read-only failure but preserve unknown outcome for an external-effect call without a terminal response
authority_contract.resource_read: one complete bounded remote read for an exact static URI or a linear conservatively matched advertised URI template with exact query/matrix variable names; stable offset and limit pagination begins only after Round 1 artifact acceptance
authority_contract.physical_lifecycle: negotiated capabilities gate listing; Host aggregate discovery reservation starts before client.open and remains through normalized candidate installation; slot failure and retirement exact-join physical identity; stdio EOF fences the slot; successful close removes the heavyweight registry entry

transport_and_bounds.official_sdk: mcp[cli]==2.0.0 and mcp-types==2.0.0, imported only through sdk_facade.py
transport_and_bounds.bounded_before_and_after_parse: a linear JSON structural scanner enforces syntax, node and depth bounds before json.loads; post-parse validation remains defense in depth
transport_and_bounds.per_slot_aggregate_reservation: all concurrent HTTP bodies and SSE event buffers share one 32 MiB slot-local byte budget
transport_and_bounds.public_only_dns: the validated address is pinned for the physical connection while the logical Host header and TLS SNI are preserved
transport_and_bounds.discovery_working_set: per-server and per-Host normalized bounds with reservation acquired before client.open, closed pagination and schema dialect validation
transport_and_bounds.remote_identity: a fixed-size domain-separated digest covers server, physical generation and the complete remote tool name before exposure
transport_and_bounds.artifact_handoff: large bounded resource and tool output use the existing Round 1 artifact/artifact_read authority

deterministic_verification.same_schema_reconnect: physical generation changed while semantic fingerprint and provider prefix remained exact
deterministic_verification.schema_change_rebase: dirty fence blocked dispatch until safe-point successor installation
deterministic_verification.confirmation_and_slot_lease: generation-bound permit, Host-wide FIFO, deny, detach, timeout, stale and close matrices passed
deterministic_verification.bounded_transport: wire frame, body, SSE, pre-allocation JSON structural scan, schema, discovery-from-open reservation, direct-tool count, shared slot-byte reservation, pinned-address policy, linear URI-template matcher, bounded remote identity, and input_required aggregate bounds passed

real_provider_dogfood.mcp_transport: local stdio fixture under a temporary workspace
real_provider_dogfood.database: fresh clean-v0 ephemeral database force-dropped after verification
real_provider_dogfood.post_review_disposition: The real-provider path passed before the final four local boundary fixes. Those fixes change only conservative resource admission, pre-parse rejection, fixed-size remote identity, and discovery reservation timing; all four are covered by deterministic local and PostgreSQL regressions, including full canonical settlement of a 5000-byte remote tool name. No second remote request was used as a correctness oracle.

production_diff.counting_scope: tracked git diff under src plus eight untracked Round 6 production modules

non_goals: advanced Go MCP viewer or dashboard
